lines: STREET LIGHTING. These lamps are switched off at 22.00 to save the county money.
Residents are advised that this has always been the case.
The notice is screwed to the lamp post with new screws. The paint on the post behind it has gone to flakes.
CASTLE BRIDGE. No toll is taken here now. The keeper is no longer employed, and is not to be paid at the gate.
CASTLE RURAL DISTRICT COUNCIL. NO BATHING.
Painted underneath, smaller, by the same sign-writer: Nobody has drowned in this lake.
He's wet to the collar, and he's watching the water. He hasn't looked at me yet.
"It's only a lake," he says. "Nobody's ever drowned in it. I'd know. I've been in it since the morning, looking."
